mercury.title: Mercury
facts: Smallest planet in our solar system
Closest planet to the Sun (57.9 million km)
Surface temperature ranges from -180°C to 430°C
Has no moons or rings
Takes 88 Earth days to orbit the Sun
Named after the Roman god of speed
Has a very thin atmosphere
Diameter is 4,879 km

venus.title: Venus
facts: Hottest planet in our solar system (462°C)
Often called Earth's sister planet due to similar size
Rotates backwards compared to most planets
Has the longest rotation period of any planet (243 Earth days)
Named after the Roman goddess of love
Thick atmosphere of carbon dioxide
No moons or rings
Diameter is 12,104 km

earth.title: Earth
facts: Only known planet with life
Has one natural satellite (the Moon)
Takes 365.25 days to orbit the Sun
Only planet not named after a god/goddess
71% of surface covered in water
Has a protective magnetic field
Average surface temperature is 15°C
Diameter is 12,742 km

mars.title: Mars
facts: Known as the Red Planet
Has two small moons (Phobos and Deimos)
Surface temperature ranges from -140°C to 20°C
Named after the Roman god of war
Has the largest volcano in the solar system (Olympus Mons)
Takes 687 Earth days to orbit the Sun
Has polar ice caps made of water and CO2
Diameter is 6,779 km

jupiter.title: Jupiter
facts: Largest planet in our solar system
Has at least 95 moons
Great Red Spot is a giant storm lasting over 400 years
Named after the king of the Roman gods
Takes 12 Earth years to orbit the Sun
Made mostly of hydrogen and helium
Has a faint ring system
Diameter is 139,820 km

saturn.title: Saturn
facts: Known for its spectacular ring system
Has at least 83 moons (including Titan)
Named after the Roman god of agriculture
Takes 29.5 Earth years to orbit the Sun
Could float in a giant bathtub (less dense than water)
Mostly made of hydrogen and helium
Average temperature is -178°C
Diameter is 116,460 km

uranus.title: Uranus
facts: First planet discovered using a telescope
Rotates on its side (98-degree tilt)
Has 27 known moons
Named after the Greek god of the sky
Takes 84 Earth years to orbit the Sun
Has a blue-green color due to methane
Temperature as low as -224°C
Diameter is 50,724 km

neptune.title: Neptune
facts: Most distant planet from the Sun
Has 14 known moons
Strongest winds in the solar system (2,100 km/h)
Named after the Roman god of the sea
Takes 165 Earth years to orbit the Sun
Has a dark spot similar to Jupiter's
Average temperature is -214°C
Diameter is 49,244 km
